AddDcdnDomain.title: AddDcdnDomain
AddDcdnDomain.summary: To add a domain name, call the AddDcdnDomain operation.

AddDcdnIpaDomain.title: AddDcdnIpaDomain
AddDcdnIpaDomain.summary: Call the AddDcdnIpaDomain operation to add a domain name for IP Application Accelerator (IPA). You can add only one accelerated domain name at a time.

BatchAddDcdnDomain.title: BatchAddDcdnDomain
BatchAddDcdnDomain.summary: Call `BatchAddDcdnDomain` to add multiple domain names.

BatchCreateDcdnWafRules.title: BatchCreateDcdnWafRules
BatchCreateDcdnWafRules.summary: Call the BatchCreateDcdnWafRules operation to set WAF mitigation rules.

BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs.title: BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs
BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs.summary: Call BatchDeleteDcdnDomainConfigs to delete configurations for multiple domain names at once.

BatchDeleteDcdnKv.title: BatchDeleteDcdnKv
BatchDeleteDcdnKv.summary: Deletes a batch of key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace.

BatchDeleteDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.title: BatchDeleteDcdnKvWithHighCapacity
BatchDeleteDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.summary: Deletes multiple key-value pairs from a specified KV namespace based on a list of keys. The maximum size of the request body is 100 MB.

BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules.title: BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules
BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules.summary: Call BatchDeleteDcdnWafRules to delete WAF rules in a batch.

BatchModifyDcdnWafRules.title: BatchModifyDcdnWafRules
BatchModifyDcdnWafRules.summary: You can call BatchModifyDcdnWafRules to modify WAF mitigation rules in a batch. This operation supports modifying configurations only in the bot management scenario.

BatchPutDcdnKv.title: BatchPutDcdnKv
BatchPutDcdnKv.summary: Adds or updates multiple key-value (KV) pairs in a specified namespace.

BatchPutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.title: BatchPutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity
BatchPutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.summary: Sets multiple key-value pairs for a specified KV namespace. The request body can be up to 100 MB.

BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs.title: BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs
BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs.summary: `BatchSetDcdnDomainConfigs` configures multiple domain names at once.

BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.title: BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs
BatchSetDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.summary: Configures IP Application Acceleration (IPA) for multiple domain names in a single operation.

BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs.title: BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs
BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs.summary: Call BatchSetDcdnWafDomainConfigs to set the protection status for multiple domain names in a batch.

BatchStartDcdnDomain.title: BatchStartDcdnDomain
BatchStartDcdnDomain.summary: Enables multiple disabled accelerated domain names in a batch. This operation changes the DomainStatus to online.

BatchStopDcdnDomain.title: BatchStopDcdnDomain
BatchStopDcdnDomain.summary: Disables one or more accelerated domain names and changes their status to offline.

CheckDcdnProjectExist.title: CheckDcdnProjectExist
CheckDcdnProjectExist.summary: Checks whether a real-time log delivery project exists.

CommitStagingRoutineCode.title: CommitStagingRoutineCode
CommitStagingRoutineCode.summary: You can call the CommitStagingRoutineCode operation to promote a staging version of your JavaScript (JS) code to the production environment.

CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest.title: CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest
CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest.summary: You can call CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest to create a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) file.

CreateDcdnDeliverTask.title: CreateDcdnDeliverTask
CreateDcdnDeliverTask.summary: Call CreateDcdnDeliverTask to create a report tracking task. After you subscribe, the system periodically sends statistical reports to you by email.

CreateDcdnSLSRealTimeLogDelivery.title: CreateDcdnSLSRealTimeLogDelivery
CreateDcdnSLSRealTimeLogDelivery.summary: Creates a real-time log delivery project.

CreateDcdnSubTask.title: CreateDcdnSubTask
CreateDcdnSubTask.summary: You can call the CreateDcdnSubTask operation to customize operations reports.

CreateDcdnWafGroup.title: CreateDcdnWafGroup
CreateDcdnWafGroup.summary: The CreateDcdnWafGroup operation creates a custom WAF rule group.

CreateDcdnWafPolicy.title: Set mitigation policies
CreateDcdnWafPolicy.summary: Invokes CreateDcdnWafPolicy to set WAF mitigation policies.

CreateSlrAndSlsProject.title: CreateSlrAndSlsProject
CreateSlrAndSlsProject.summary: Creates a service-linked role (SLR) and a Log Service project.

DeleteDcdnDeliverTask.title: DeleteDcdnDeliverTask
DeleteDcdnDeliverTask.summary: Deletes a subscribed report task by its task ID.

DeleteDcdnIpaDomain.title: DeleteDcdnIpaDomain
DeleteDcdnIpaDomain.summary: You can call the DeleteDcdnIpaDomain operation to delete an accelerated domain name for IP Application Accelerator (IPA).

DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig.title: DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig
DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig.summary: You can call the DeleteDcdnIpaSpecificConfig operation to delete the IP Application Accelerator (IPA) layer configuration for a specified domain name.

DeleteDcdnKv.title: DeleteDcdnKv
DeleteDcdnKv.summary: EdgeKV provides a global key-value (KV) database on Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) edge nodes. You can call the DeleteDcdnKv operation to delete a KV pair from a namespace.

DeleteDcdnKvNamespace.title: DeleteDcdnKvNamespace
DeleteDcdnKvNamespace.summary: Deletes a specified namespace from your account.

DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject.title: DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject
DeleteDcdnRealTimeLogProject.summary: Deletes real-time logs of a log delivery project.

DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig.title: DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig
DeleteDcdnSpecificConfig.summary: Deletes a specific configuration for a domain name.

DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig.title: DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig
DeleteDcdnSpecificStagingConfig.summary: Deletes one or more staging (grayscale) configurations for an accelerated domain name.

DeleteDcdnSubTask.title: DeleteDcdnSubTask
DeleteDcdnSubTask.summary: You can call the DeleteDcdnSubTask operation to delete all customized operations reports.

DeleteDcdnWafGroup.title: DeleteDcdnWafGroup
DeleteDcdnWafGroup.summary: You can call the DeleteDcdnWafGroup operation to delete a custom WAF rule group.

DeleteRoutine.title: DeleteRoutine
DeleteRoutine.summary: Deletes the configuration for an Edge Routine function.

DeleteRoutineCodeRevision.title: DeleteRoutineCodeRevision
DeleteRoutineCodeRevision.summary: Deletes a specific code revision of an Edge Routine.

DeleteRoutineConfEnvs.title: DeleteRoutineConfEnvs
DeleteRoutineConfEnvs.summary: Deletes custom grayscale environments from the environment list of an Edge Routine.

DescribeDcdnAclFields.title: DescribeDcdnAclFields
DescribeDcdnAclFields.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnAclFields operation to query the fields that are available for access control rules.

DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData
DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnBgpBpsData operation to query bandwidth data for Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) acceleration at a 5-minute granularity.

DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData
DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnBgpTrafficData operation to query Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) acceleration traffic data at a five-minute granularity.

DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions.title: DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions
DescribeDcdnBlockedRegions.summary: Queries the countries and regions supported by the Location Blacklist feature.

DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail.title: DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail
DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnCertificateDetail operation to query the details of a DCDN certificate.

DescribeDcdnCertificateList.title: DescribeDcdnCertificateList
DescribeDcdnCertificateList.summary: Queries a list of certificates by domain name.

DescribeDcdnDdosService.title: DescribeDcdnDdosService
DescribeDcdnDdosService.summary: Queries the status of the DCDN DDoS service.

DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo.title: DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo
DescribeDcdnDdosSpecInfo.summary: Queries the edition specifications for Anti-DDoS for DCDN.

DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains.title: DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains
DescribeDcdnDeletedDomains.summary: Queries the domain names that have been deleted from your account.

DescribeDcdnDeliverList.title: DescribeDcdnDeliverList
DescribeDcdnDeliverList.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDeliverList operation to query a list of all report tracking tasks.

DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainBpsData to query network bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer.title: DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer
DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainBpsDataByLayer operation to query bandwidth data by protocol.

DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate.title: DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate
DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainByCertificate operation to query domain names based on certificate information.

DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog.title: DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog
DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainCcActivityLog to query logs of requests blocked by CC protection rules.

DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo.title: DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo
DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainCertificateInfo operation to query the certificate information for a specified domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainCname.title: Check whether CNAME configuration of a domain name is complete
DescribeDcdnDomainCname.summary: Checks the CNAME resolution of accelerated domain names to determine whether CNAME configuration is complete.

DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs.title: DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs
DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainConfigs to get the configurations of an accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainDetail.title: Query domain name details
DescribeDcdnDomainDetail.summary: Queries the basic configuration information of a specified accelerated domain name by calling DescribeDcdnDomainDetail.

DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData
DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainHitRateData to query the byte hit ratio of one or more domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData
DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeData to query the total number and proportions of HTTP return codes for accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer.title: DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer
DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainHttpCodeDataByLayer operation to obtain HTTP status code data classified by protocol.

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData to query network bandwidth monitoring data for Layer 4 acceleration of accelerated domain names. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData
DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainIpaConnData operation to query the number of connections for IP Application Accelerator (IPA).

DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIpaTrafficData to query Layer 4 traffic monitoring data for accelerated domain names. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainIspData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainIspData
DescribeDcdnDomainIspData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIspData to query daily statistics on carrier distribution for an accelerated domain name. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainLog.title: DescribeDcdnDomainLog
DescribeDcdnDomainLog.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainLog operation to query the download URLs of raw access logs for a specified domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData
DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData.summary: Calls the DescribeDcdnDomainMultiUsageData operation to query the billing data for various metrics of one or more DCDN accelerated domain names. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes. This operation does not return data for billing items that are not request-based.

DescribeDcdnDomainOriginBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainOriginBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainOriginBpsData.summary: Queries the back-to-origin bandwidth monitoring data for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainOriginTrafficData to query monitoring data about back-to-origin traffic for domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainProperty.title: DescribeDcdnDomainProperty
DescribeDcdnDomainProperty.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainProperty operation to query the protocol type of an IP Application Accelerator (IPA) domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainPvData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainPvData
DescribeDcdnDomainPvData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainPvData to query page view (PV) statistics for a domain name at a minimum granularity of one hour.

DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnDomainQpsData operation to query the queries per second (QPS) for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer.title: DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer
DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer to query the queries per second (QPS) of an accelerated domain name by protocol.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeBpsData operation to query the real-time network bandwidth of a domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateDat.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateDat.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData operation to query real-time byte hit ratio data for one or more domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData to batch query traffic and request data for accelerated domain names at a 1-minute granularity. The data is aggregated by region and carrier. The maximum time range for a single query is 10 minutes.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData operation to query the total number and proportions of real-time HTTP return codes for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData operation to obtain the queries per second (QPS) data for an accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData operation to query the real-time request hit rate of one or more accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData to query the real-time back-to-origin bandwidth data for an accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeDat.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeDat.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData operation to query real-time data on the proportions of origin-fetch HTTP return codes for an accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcTrafficData operation to query real-time back-to-origin traffic data for accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeTrafficData operation to query traffic monitoring data for an accelerated domain name over a time interval.

DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData
DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRegionData operation to query daily statistics about the regional distribution of users for an accelerated domain name. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig.title: DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig
DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainStagingConfig operation to query the configurations of a staging environment.

DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit.title: DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit
DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainTopReferVisit operation to query the top referrers for a domain name by the number of visits. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit.title: DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit
DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainTopUrlVisit to retrieve the top URLs for an accelerated domain name on a specific day.

DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainTrafficData.summary: Queries the network traffic data of accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData
DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainUsageData operation to query the usage data of a domain name in a specific billing region.

DescribeDcdnDomainUvData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainUvData
DescribeDcdnDomainUvData.summary: Call DescribeDcdnDomainUvData to obtain statistics about unique visitors (UVs) for accelerated domain names at a 1-hour granularity. You can query data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData
DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketBpsData operation to query network bandwidth data for a domain name that uses the WebSocket protocol.

DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketHttpCodeData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketHttpCodeData
DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketHttpCodeData.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketHttpCodeData operation to query the total number and proportions of HTTP return codes for the WebSocket protocol for one or more domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData.title: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData
DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData.summary: Queries WebSocket network traffic data for accelerated domain names.

DescribeDcdnDomainsBySource.title: DescribeDcdnDomainsBySource
DescribeDcdnDomainsBySource.summary: Queries DCDN accelerated domain names by specified origin servers.

DescribeDcdnErUsageData.title: DescribeDcdnErUsageData
DescribeDcdnErUsageData.summary: The DescribeDcdnErUsageData operation queries the number of times an Edge Routine (ER) is executed.

DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig.title: DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig
DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig.summary: Call DescribeDcdnFullDomainsBlockIPConfig to query the IP address blocklist configuration.

DescribeDcdnHttpsDomainList.title: DescribeDcdnHttpsDomainList
DescribeDcdnHttpsDomainList.summary: Queries the information about all certificates under your account.

DescribeDcdnIpInfo.title: DescribeDcdnIpInfo
DescribeDcdnIpInfo.summary: Call DescribeDcdnIpInfo to check if an IP address belongs to an Alibaba Cloud DCDN node.

DescribeDcdnIpaDomainCidr.title: DescribeDcdnIpaDomainCidr
DescribeDcdnIpaDomainCidr.summary: Call DescribeDcdnIpaDomainCidr to query the back-to-origin IP address blocks for an accelerated domain name in IP Application Accelerator (IPA). This API operation requires access permissions. To use this operation, submit a ticket.

DescribeDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.title: DescribeDcdnIpaDomainConfigs
DescribeDcdnIpaDomainConfigs.summary: Queries the configurations of a domain name.

DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail.title: DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail
DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail.summary: Call DescribeDcdnIpaDomainDetail to get the basic configuration of a specified accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnIpaService.title: DescribeDcdnIpaService
DescribeDcdnIpaService.summary: Call DescribeDcdnIpaService to query the status of the DCDN IP Application Accelerator (IPA) service. The returned information includes the current billing method, service activation time, the next billing method to take effect, and the current service status.

DescribeDcdnIpaUserDomains.title: DescribeDcdnIpaUserDomains
DescribeDcdnIpaUserDomains.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnIpaUserDomains operation to query all IP Application Accelerator (IPA) domain names that belong to your account. You can perform a fuzzy search or filter the domain names by status.

DescribeDcdnKvAccount.title: DescribeDcdnKvAccount
DescribeDcdnKvAccount.summary: Queries your account and its namespaces.

DescribeDcdnKvAccountStatus.title: DescribeDcdnKvAccountStatus
DescribeDcdnKvAccountStatus.summary: Queries the status of the key-value (KV) store for an account.

DescribeDcdnL2Ips.title: DescribeDcdnL2Ips
DescribeDcdnL2Ips.summary: Queries CIDR blocks of Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) points of presence (POPs).

DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus.title: DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus
DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus.summary: The DescribeDcdnOriginSiteHealthStatus operation queries the health status of the origin server for a DCDN-accelerated domain name.

DescribeDcdnRealTimeDeliveryField.title: DescribeDcdnRealTimeDeliveryField
DescribeDcdnRealTimeDeliveryField.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnRealTimeDeliveryField operation to query all fields for real-time logs.

DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota.title: DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota
DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota.summary: Call DescribeDcdnRefreshQuota to query the daily limits and remaining quotas for URL refreshes, URL prefetches, and folder refreshes.

DescribeDcdnRefreshTaskById.title: DescribeDcdnRefreshTaskById
DescribeDcdnRefreshTaskById.summary: Queries the status of refresh or preload tasks by task ID to verify their completion across the network.

DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks.title: DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks
DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks.summary: Call DescribeDcdnRefreshTasks to query the completion status of refresh and preload tasks submitted within the last 3 days.

DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp.title: Query regions and iSPs
DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp.summary: Queries the list of regions and Internet service providers (ISPs) by calling DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp.

DescribeDcdnReport.title: DescribeDcdnReport
DescribeDcdnReport.summary: Call DescribeDcdnReport to query the data of a customized report.

DescribeDcdnReportList.title: DescribeDcdnReportList
DescribeDcdnReportList.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnReportList operation to query a list of all custom reports.

DescribeDcdnSLSRealTimeLogType.title: DescribeDcdnSLSRealTimeLogType
DescribeDcdnSLSRealTimeLogType.summary: Queries supported types of real-time logs.

DescribeDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery.title: DescribeDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery
DescribeDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery operation to query the configurations of a real-time log delivery project.

DescribeDcdnSMCertificateDetail.title: DescribeDcdnSMCertificateDetail
DescribeDcdnSMCertificateDetail.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnSMCertificateDetail operation to query the details of an SM certificate.

DescribeDcdnSMCertificateList.title: DescribeDcdnSMCertificateList
DescribeDcdnSMCertificateList.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnSMCertificateList operation to query the list of SM certificates for a specified domain name.

DescribeDcdnSSLCertificateList.title: DescribeDcdnSSLCertificateList
DescribeDcdnSSLCertificateList.summary: Queries a list of SSL certificates for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnSecFuncInfo.title: DescribeDcdnSecFuncInfo
DescribeDcdnSecFuncInfo.summary: Queries the options for the Edge Security drop-down list in the DCDN console.

DescribeDcdnSecSpecInfo.title: DescribeDcdnSecSpecInfo
DescribeDcdnSecSpecInfo.summary: Queries the versions of Secure DCDN and the supported security rules.

DescribeDcdnService.title: DescribeDcdnService
DescribeDcdnService.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnService operation to query the status of the DCDN service. The status includes the current billing method, the service activation time, the next billing method that will take effect, and the current service status.

DescribeDcdnStagingIp.title: DescribeDcdnStagingIp
DescribeDcdnStagingIp.summary: Call DescribeDcdnStagingIp to obtain the valid virtual IP addresses (VIPs) of nodes in public preview.

DescribeDcdnSubList.title: DescribeDcdnSubList
DescribeDcdnSubList.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnSubList operation to query customized report tasks.

DescribeDcdnTagResources.title: DescribeDcdnTagResources
DescribeDcdnTagResources.summary: Call DescribeDcdnTagResources to query tags for resources.

DescribeDcdnTopDomainsByFlow.title: DescribeDcdnTopDomainsByFlow
DescribeDcdnTopDomainsByFlow.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnTopDomainsByFlow operation to query your domain names ranked by traffic. You can retrieve data from the last 90 days.

DescribeDcdnUserBillHistory.title: DescribeDcdnUserBillHistory
DescribeDcdnUserBillHistory.summary: You can call DescribeDcdnUserBillHistory to query historical bills for a period of up to one month.

DescribeDcdnUserBillType.title: DescribeDcdnUserBillType
DescribeDcdnUserBillType.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserBillType operation to query the billing method for a user.

DescribeDcdnUserCertificateExpireCount.title: DescribeDcdnUserCertificateExpireCount
DescribeDcdnUserCertificateExpireCount.summary: Call DescribeDcdnUserCertificateExpireCount to query the number of domain names with expired DCDN certificates.

DescribeDcdnUserConfigs.title: DescribeDcdnUserConfigs
DescribeDcdnUserConfigs.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserConfigs operation to query configurations related to security features.

DescribeDcdnUserDomains.title: DescribeDcdnUserDomains
DescribeDcdnUserDomains.summary: Call DescribeDcdnUserDomains to query all DCDN domain names under your account. This operation supports filtering by fuzzy match and domain status.

DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc.title: DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc
DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnUserDomainsByFunc operation to query all DCDN domain names that are associated with your account and have a specific feature configured. The feature is specified by FuncId.

DescribeDcdnUserQuota.title: DescribeDcdnUserQuota
DescribeDcdnUserQuota.summary: Call DescribeDcdnUserQuota to query resource quotas and usage.

DescribeDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField.title: Query user-selected field list
DescribeDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField.summary: Queries the list of fields selected by a user for real-time log delivery.

DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage.title: DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage
DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnUserResourcePackage operation to query information about all your resource plans, such as the total amount, remaining amount, effective time, expiration time, and status.

DescribeDcdnUserSecDrop.title: DescribeDcdnUserSecDrop
DescribeDcdnUserSecDrop.summary: Queries the number of requests that are blocked by a security feature of DCDN.

DescribeDcdnUserSecDropByMinute.title: DescribeDcdnUserSecDropByMinute
DescribeDcdnUserSecDropByMinute.summary: Call DescribeDcdnUserSecDropByMinute to query the total number of blocked security messages at the application layer of edge nodes within a specific time period.

DescribeDcdnUserTags.title: DescribeDcdnUserTags
DescribeDcdnUserTags.summary: Call DescribeDcdnUserTags to query user tags.

DescribeDcdnUserVipsByDomain.title: Query L1 node IP list
DescribeDcdnUserVipsByDomain.summary: Queries the IP address list of a domain name by calling DescribeDcdnUserVipsByDomain.

DescribeDcdnVerifyContent.title: DescribeDcdnVerifyContent
DescribeDcdnVerifyContent.summary: Call DescribeDcdnVerifyContent to get the ownership verification content for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnWafBotAppKey.title: DescribeDcdnWafBotAppKey
DescribeDcdnWafBotAppKey.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnWafBotAppKey operation to query the SDK authentication key for your Alibaba Cloud account. This key is required for SDK initialization and must be included in your integration code.

DescribeDcdnWafDefaultRules.title: DescribeDcdnWafDefaultRules
DescribeDcdnWafDefaultRules.summary: Calls the DescribeDcdnWafDefaultRules operation to query the default configurations of WAF rules.

DescribeDcdnWafDomain.title: DescribeDcdnWafDomain
DescribeDcdnWafDomain.summary: Call DescribeDcdnWafDomain to query all accelerated domain names protected by WAF and retrieve their details, such as ACL status, CC protection status, creation status, and WAF status.

DescribeDcdnWafDomainDetail.title: DescribeDcdnWafDomainDetail
DescribeDcdnWafDomainDetail.summary: You can call DescribeDcdnWafDomainDetail to query the mitigation policies for a specified domain name.

DescribeDcdnWafDomains.title: DescribeDcdnWafDomains
DescribeDcdnWafDomains.summary: Queries the accelerated domain names that are protected by WAF. This operation supports fuzzy search.

DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo.title: DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo
DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo.summary: Call DescribeDcdnWafFilterInfo to query the match fields, logical operators, and match content available for custom mitigation policies.

DescribeDcdnWafGeoInfo.title: DescribeDcdnWafGeoInfo
DescribeDcdnWafGeoInfo.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnWafGeoInfo operation to query the countries and regions supported by the Web Application Firewall (WAF) Location Blacklist feature.

DescribeDcdnWafGroup.title: DescribeDcdnWafGroup
DescribeDcdnWafGroup.summary: Queries a custom Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule group. The results are paginated.

DescribeDcdnWafGroups.title: DescribeDcdnWafGroups
DescribeDcdnWafGroups.summary: You can call DescribeDcdnWafGroups to query a list of custom Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule groups.

DescribeDcdnWafLogs.title: DescribeDcdnWafLogs
DescribeDcdnWafLogs.summary: Queries the download URLs of offline block logs generated by Web Application Firewall (WAF) for a domain name.

DescribeDcdnWafPolicies.title: DescribeDcdnWafPolicies
DescribeDcdnWafPolicies.summary: Queries configured Web Application Firewall (WAF) mitigation policies.

DescribeDcdnWafPolicy.title: DescribeDcdnWafPolicy
DescribeDcdnWafPolicy.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnWafPolicy operation to retrieve the details of a specific mitigation policy.

DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains.title: DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains
DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains operation to query the accelerated domain names that are protected by a specific Web Application Firewall (WAF) policy.

DescribeDcdnWafPolicyValidDomains.title: DescribeDcdnWafPolicyValidDomains
DescribeDcdnWafPolicyValidDomains.summary: Call DescribeDcdnWafPolicyValidDomains to query the domain names that can be attached to custom mitigation policies.

DescribeDcdnWafRule.title: DescribeDcdnWafRule
DescribeDcdnWafRule.summary: Call the DescribeDcdnWafRule operation to retrieve the details of a specified protection rule.

DescribeDcdnWafRules.title: DescribeDcdnWafRules
DescribeDcdnWafRules.summary: You can call DescribeDcdnWafRules to query the details of configured protection rules.

DescribeDcdnWafScenes.title: DescribeDcdnWafScenes
DescribeDcdnWafScenes.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnWafScenes operation to query the supported protection scenarios.

DescribeDcdnWafService.title: DescribeDcdnWafService
DescribeDcdnWafService.summary: Call DescribeDcdnWafService to query the status of the DCDN Web Application Firewall (WAF) service, including the service activation time, edition, current status, and billing methods for requests and rules.

DescribeDcdnWafSpecInfo.title: DescribeDcdnWafSpecInfo
DescribeDcdnWafSpecInfo.summary: You can call the DescribeDcdnWafSpecInfo operation to query information about the edition of DCDN WAF that is in use.

DescribeDcdnWafUsageData.title: DescribeDcdnWafUsageData
DescribeDcdnWafUsageData.summary: Queries usage data for Web Application Firewall (WAF).

DescribeDcdnsecService.title: DescribeDcdnsecService
DescribeDcdnsecService.summary: Call DescribeDcdnsecService to query the status of your Secure DCDN service, such as its activation time, expiration time, and current service status.

DescribeDdosAllEventList.title: DescribeDdosAllEventList
DescribeDdosAllEventList.summary: Queries a list of attack events.

DescribeEncryptRoutineUid.title: DescribeEncryptRoutineUid
DescribeEncryptRoutineUid.summary: Queries an Edge Routine (ER), such as its encrypted RoutineUid.

DescribeHighlightInfo.title: DescribeHighlightInfo
DescribeHighlightInfo.summary: You can call the DescribeHighlightInfo operation to query highlighted data for attack details. Use the TraceId from the log of a request that was blocked by Basic Web Protection to find the specific reason for the block. The highlighted data is the content that was blocked by the Basic Web Protection module.

DescribeKvRealTimeQpsData.title: DescribeKvRealTimeQpsData
DescribeKvRealTimeQpsData.summary: Queries the real-time queries per second (QPS) data of a key-value (KV) store.

DescribeKvUsageData.title: DescribeKvUsageData
DescribeKvUsageData.summary: Queries the usage data for KV Store.

DescribeRDDomainConfig.title: DescribeRDDomainConfig
DescribeRDDomainConfig.summary: You can call the DescribeRDDomainConfig operation to query the feature configurations of your domain names.

DescribeRoutine.title: Query metadata of an edge function
DescribeRoutine.summary: Queries the metadata of a specific edge function (EdgeRoutine), including the EdgeRoutine configuration, configuration version, and code version for each environment.

DescribeRoutineCanaryEnvs.title: DescribeRoutineCanaryEnvs
DescribeRoutineCanaryEnvs.summary: Retrieves a list of canary environments supported by Edge Routine (ER).

DescribeRoutineCodeRevision.title: Get JS code of an edge function
DescribeRoutineCodeRevision.summary: Queries the JavaScript (JS) code of a specific version of an edge function.

DescribeRoutineRelatedDomains.title: DescribeRoutineRelatedDomains
DescribeRoutineRelatedDomains.summary: Queries the domain names that are associated with an Edge Routine.

DescribeRoutineSpec.title: DescribeRoutineSpec
DescribeRoutineSpec.summary: Call DescribeRoutineSpec to obtain the available specifications for Edge Routines. During the internal test phase, three CPU time slice specifications are available: 5 ms, 50 ms, and 100 ms.

DescribeRoutineUserInfo.title: DescribeRoutineUserInfo
DescribeRoutineUserInfo.summary: Call DescribeRoutineUserInfo to query information about your Alibaba Cloud account, including the attached subdomain and the list of created routines.

DescribeUserDcdnIpaStatus.title: DescribeUserDcdnIpaStatus
DescribeUserDcdnIpaStatus.summary: You can call the DescribeUserDcdnIpaStatus operation to query whether IP Application Accelerator (IPA) is activated and whether your account has an overdue payment.

DescribeUserDcdnStatus.title: DescribeUserDcdnStatus
DescribeUserDcdnStatus.summary: Call DescribeUserDcdnStatus to query whether your Dynamic Route for CDN (DCDN) service has overdue payments and is active.

DescribeUserErStatus.title: DescribeUserErStatus
DescribeUserErStatus.summary: Call DescribeUserErStatus to check whether Edge Routine (ER) is enabled or has an overdue payment.

DescribeUserLogserviceStatus.title: DescribeUserLogserviceStatus
DescribeUserLogserviceStatus.summary: Call the DescribeUserLogserviceStatus operation to check whether Log Service is activated or has overdue payments.

EditRoutineConf.title: Modify edge function ER configuration
EditRoutineConf.summary: Modifies the configuration of an edge function (ER).

GetDcdnKv.title: GetDcdnKv
GetDcdnKv.summary: Queries the value of a key.

GetDcdnKvDetail.title: GetDcdnKvDetail
GetDcdnKvDetail.summary: Queries the value and TTL of a key-value pair.

GetDcdnKvStatus.title: GetDcdnKvStatus
GetDcdnKvStatus.summary: Queries the status of a key-value (KV) pair by key.

ListDcdnKv.title: ListDcdnKv
ListDcdnKv.summary: You can call ListDcdnKv to traverse the key-value pairs in a specified namespace.

ListDcdnRealTimeDeliveryProject.title: ListDcdnRealTimeDeliveryProject
ListDcdnRealTimeDeliveryProject.summary: Queries a real-time log delivery project.

ModifyDCdnDomainSchdmByProperty.title: ModifyDCdnDomainSchdmByProperty
ModifyDCdnDomainSchdmByProperty.summary: Modifies the acceleration region for a domain name by specifying a property.

ModifyDcdnWafGroup.title: ModifyDcdnWafGroup
ModifyDcdnWafGroup.summary: You can call the ModifyDcdnWafGroup operation to modify a custom WAF rule group.

ModifyDcdnWafPolicy.title: ModifyDcdnWafPolicy
ModifyDcdnWafPolicy.summary: Modifies the name or status of a specified mitigation policy.

ModifyDcdnWafPolicyDomains.title: ModifyDcdnWafPolicyDomains
ModifyDcdnWafPolicyDomains.summary: You can call the ModifyDcdnWafPolicyDomains operation to modify the domain names that are attached to a specific mitigation policy.

ModifyDcdnWafRule.title: ModifyDcdnWafRule
ModifyDcdnWafRule.summary: Modifies the name, status, or configuration of a protection rule.

OpenDcdnService.title: OpenDcdnService
OpenDcdnService.summary: You can call the OpenDcdnService operation to activate DCDN.

PreloadDcdnObjectCaches.title: Prefetch uRLs
PreloadDcdnObjectCaches.summary: Prefetches content from the origin server to L2 Cache nodes so that users can directly hit the cache on their first visit, which reduces the load on the origin server.

PublishDcdnStagingConfigToProduction.title: PublishDcdnStagingConfigToProduction
PublishDcdnStagingConfigToProduction.summary: Publishes the DCDN configuration from the staging environment to the production environment.

PublishRoutineCodeRevision.title: PublishRoutineCodeRevision
PublishRoutineCodeRevision.summary: Publishes a specific version of Edge Routine (ER) code to an environment.

PutDcdnKv.title: PutDcdnKv
PutDcdnKv.summary: The PutDcdnKv operation sets a key-value (KV) pair for a specified namespace.

PutDcdnKvNamespace.title: PutDcdnKvNamespace
PutDcdnKvNamespace.summary: You can call PutDcdnKvNamespace to add a namespace to your account.

PutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.title: PutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity
PutDcdnKvWithHighCapacity.summary: Sets a key-value pair for a namespace. This operation supports a request body of up to 25 MB.

RefreshDcdnObjectCacheByCacheTag.title: RefreshDcdnObjectCacheByCacheTag
RefreshDcdnObjectCacheByCacheTag.summary: After the cache tag feature is enabled, you can call RefreshObjectCacheByCacheTag to refresh content by specifying cache tags.

RefreshDcdnObjectCaches.title: Cache purge
RefreshDcdnObjectCaches.summary: Refreshes file content on nodes and refreshes the content of specified URLs to cache nodes. Supports batch URL refresh.

RefreshErObjectCaches.title: Refresh edge function caches
RefreshErObjectCaches.summary: Refreshes caches written through the edge function Cache API and caches written through fetch subrequests. Supports batch URL refresh.

RefreshErObjectCachesByCacheTag.title: RefreshErObjectCachesByCacheTag
RefreshErObjectCachesByCacheTag.summary: Refreshes content using a cache tag in Edge Routine (ER) scenarios.

RollbackDcdnStagingConfig.title: RollbackDcdnStagingConfig
RollbackDcdnStagingConfig.summary: Rolls back the staging Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) configuration to the production version.

SetDcdnDomainCSRCertificate.title: SetDcdnDomainCSRCertificate
SetDcdnDomainCSRCertificate.summary: Sets the HTTPS certificate for a specified domain name.

SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate.title: SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate
SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate.summary: You can call the SetDcdnDomainSMCertificate operation to configure an SM certificate for a specific accelerated domain name.

SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate.title: SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate
SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate.summary: You can call SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate to enable or disable the certificate feature for a domain name and update the certificate information.

SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig.title: SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig
SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig.summary: Call SetDcdnDomainStagingConfig to set or modify the configurations for a domain name in the staging environment.

SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP.title: SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP
SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP.summary: Call the SetDcdnFullDomainsBlockIP operation to block or unblock specified IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

SetDcdnUserConfig.title: SetDcdnUserConfig
SetDcdnUserConfig.summary: Call SetDcdnUserConfig to configure user settings.

StartDcdnDomain.title: StartDcdnDomain
StartDcdnDomain.summary: Call StartDcdnDomain to enable a disabled accelerated domain name. This operation changes the DomainStatus to online.

StartDcdnIpaDomain.title: StartDcdnIpaDomain
StartDcdnIpaDomain.summary: You can call the StartDcdnIpaDomain operation to enable a disabled accelerated domain name. This changes the status of the domain name to `online`.

StopDcdnDomain.title: StopDcdnDomain
StopDcdnDomain.summary: Call StopDcdnDomain to disable an accelerated domain name and change its DomainStatus to offline.

StopDcdnIpaDomain.title: StopDcdnIpaDomain
StopDcdnIpaDomain.summary: Call StopDcdnIpaDomain to disable an accelerated domain name. This operation sets the domain's status to offline.

TagDcdnResources.title: TagDcdnResources
TagDcdnResources.summary: You can call TagDcdnResources to add tags to resources.

UntagDcdnResources.title: UntagDcdnResources
UntagDcdnResources.summary: You can call UntagDcdnResources to delete tags from resources.

UpdateDcdnDeliverTask.title: UpdateDcdnDeliverTask
UpdateDcdnDeliverTask.summary: Call the UpdateDcdnDeliverTask operation to update a subscribed report task by its tracking task ID.

UpdateDcdnDomain.title: UpdateDcdnDomain
UpdateDcdnDomain.summary: Updates the configurations of an accelerated domain name.

UpdateDcdnIpaDomain.title: UpdateDcdnIpaDomain
UpdateDcdnIpaDomain.summary: You can call the UpdateDcdnIpaDomain operation to modify an accelerated domain name for IPA.

UpdateDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery.title: UpdateDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery
UpdateDcdnSLSRealtimeLogDelivery.summary: Updates a real-time log delivery project.

UpdateDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField.title: UpdateDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField
UpdateDcdnUserRealTimeDeliveryField.summary: Updates the fields in real-time log entries.

UploadRoutineCode.title: Upload edge function code
UploadRoutineCode.summary: Uploads the code of an edge function.

UploadStagingRoutineCode.title: Upload staging code for an edge function
UploadStagingRoutineCode.summary: Uploads staging code for an edge function (ER).

VerifyDcdnDomainOwner.title: VerifyDcdnDomainOwner
VerifyDcdnDomainOwner.summary: Verifies the ownership of a domain name.
